title: skill contribute/edit: Korean-UI app relaxed encoding-guard threshold
desc: HasEncodingRisk's default 0.1pct Korean threshold rejected legit skill docs for Korean HTS apps. Relaxed to 30pct for Korean-UI app categories (hts-*, heroes*, kiwoom*, tuhon*, xingq*, invest-kr, claude-desktop) so UIA labels can be transcribed verbatim. Other apps keep the strict limit.
